title.zh: Hackers Jailbreak iPhone 18 Pro on Stage, and It Survives a Reboot
title.en: Hackers Jailbreak iPhone 18 Pro on Stage, and It Survives a Reboot

current_state.zh: Security firm Calif.io demonstrated an untethered, reboot-persistent jailbreak of an iPhone 18 Pro on iOS 27.0.1 at the Hexacon conference in Paris, without disclosing the underlying vulnerabilities or releasing a tool.
current_state.en: Security firm Calif.io demonstrated an untethered, reboot-persistent jailbreak of an iPhone 18 Pro on iOS 27.0.1 at the Hexacon conference in Paris, without disclosing the underlying vulnerabilities or releasing a tool.
